_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic strip panel, black brush-pen ink line with muddy early-2000s digital flat colors, rubbery kinetic linework, mid-2000s webcomic look, limited palette, slightly misregistered fills. model sheet of a scruffy low-slung terrier-hound mix with a long body, short legs, folded velvet ears and a wiry white-and-tan coat; standing, curled in a tight spiral, chin resting on a slipper, mid-bark at a wave, being carried in a blanket; plus three heads at ages one, eight and fifteen with the muzzle graying and the eyes clouding; labeled BARNABY 1999–2014. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, painterly, glossy, watermark, extra fingers
